PASSAGE
 A game by Jason Rohrer, 2007

 Rohrer placed Passage in the public domain. His page for the game, with donation information:
 https://hcsoftware.sourceforge.net/passage/

 Slide a finger to walk; hold to keep walking. Sound on.
 The game lasts five minutes.

 This Android port is free and unofficial, and not made or endorsed by Jason Rohrer.

 Tap to continue
